title: Prepare a training service and find its customers
goal: Open a separate training service, distinguish the base, mode and list, and find where customers belong. No coding is required.

prerequisites.text: No 1C experience is required. You need a computer with a suitable official platform and a new empty folder. Installation and preparation are explained below.

sections.title: The story of a workshop
paragraphs: A workshop accepts diagnostic and setup requests. An employee needs to know who called, which service was selected and how much time it needs. We use fictional training records to learn without anyone’s personal data. Today requires no calculations or programming: first find where work is stored.

The 1C platform runs applications. A configuration describes our service: lists, fields and rules. An infobase stores the application and its data. Nexus shows the lesson; actual cards are created in a separate 1C window. These distinctions help you choose the right action; they are not an architecture examination.

sections.title: How to tell which window you are using
paragraphs: The launcher selects an infobase. Designer changes the application’s structure; Enterprise opens it for user work. Customers and requests belong in the latter. Designer is needed now only to prepare the new training service from a supplied file.

A section groups application commands. A list shows records of one kind, such as customers. A card is the window for one record; we open one next lesson. This small training service need not resemble your organisation’s accounting system: the configuration determines command names and placement.

sections.title: Preparation with no missing steps
paragraphs: Use an officially installed 1C platform. If it is unavailable, open the training-version page below and follow the supplier’s installation and licence instructions. Nexus neither installs 1C nor bypasses licensing. Reading remains available, but application actions are not performed until installation is complete.

In the launcher choose Add → create a new infobase → without configuration for development. Name it NexusReferenceService. Choose a new empty folder on your computer. Compare its path with introductory and working bases: it must be another location. If an infobase already occupies it, cancel; do not clear the folder for an exercise. Finish the wizard and select the new item.

Download NexusTrainingServiceDeskReportsV2.cf below and remember its folder. This is the project’s training service configuration. Open only the new infobase in Designer. If necessary choose Configuration → Open configuration, then Configuration → Load configuration from file and select the downloaded .cf. Confirm replacement only in this verified new empty base. If existing work is visible, cancel and select the new base.

After loading, press Ctrl+S and F7 (Update database configuration) and confirm the changes in the new base. Press F5 to start it. In Enterprise mode open Customers (Клиенты). This small training configuration may show commands directly in its panel rather than in a large application section. Clear the search box: an empty list is expected in a new base. Do not confuse this with a failed load.

sections.title: What an empty list means
paragraphs: Compare the action example with the expected observation. We loaded the service description into a new base, not a list of real people. Customers is therefore empty. A .cf file contains configuration, not your future customer records. An empty list with search cleared is the correct starting point for the next lesson.

If the list is not empty, read the selected name and directory, clear the search and check whether this is an earlier exercise. Do not delete records merely to make a blank screen. Use another new folder for an independent experiment and preserve the previous work.

code.source: Новая база → загрузить учебный .cf → F7 → F5 → Клиенты
code.output: The training service is open. With search cleared, the new base has no customers yet.

sections.title: Check the location and return
paragraphs: Close the user window and select your launcher item again. Compare the directory, reopen it in Enterprise mode and find Customers again. Returning to the same base matters more than memorising a window position. A list label can change; similar labels do not prove identical storage.

Keep a brief record: the selected training base, opened mode, located list and observation. A Nexus self-report remains a self-report. Next we create a first card, giving the empty list a clear reason to change.

practice.title: On your own: your training service
practice.task: Prepare a separate new NexusReferenceService using the lesson steps. Open Customers, clear search and record what you see. Close and reopen the same base using its item and directory. Do not load the .cf into an earlier or working infobase.
practice.environment: Official installed 1C in a separate training infobase. Nexus shows the lesson and keeps an optional draft; it does not run this program.
practice.externalRoute: Follow the steps labelled by application. The self-report field records your external observation; it is not Nexus verification.

passport.goal: Prepare your own service for the next two lessons.
passport.start: A new empty folder, the platform and the supplied training .cf.
passport.where: Prepare in Designer; open the list in Enterprise.
passport.knowledge: The lesson includes the concepts and complete preparation.
passport.result: Service commands and an empty Customers list in the new base.
passport.checks: Reopen the same base and compare its name/directory and list.
passport.errors: Loading into an earlier base; omitted F7; search hiding rows.
passport.recovery: Cancel an incorrect selection before loading. Preserve existing bases and use a new folder for another experiment.

cases.label: New infobase
cases.output: The new base has 0 customer records; previous bases are preserved.

criteria: A separate new folder was used.
The service actually opens and can be found again after closing.
The record describes observations; unperformed work is explicit.
practice.hint: Do not look for customer records in the Designer tree: the user list opens in Enterprise.

referenceSolution.source: Example reasoning: a new separate directory was checked; the training .cf was loaded there and applied with F7. Enterprise opens Customers with search cleared. The new base contains no customer records: the file supplied the service description, not my customers. After closing, I select the same item and path and find the list again. Previous bases remain. This is an example record, not confirmation of your actions.
paragraphs: A reference for reasoning and expected observation. It neither fills your record nor certifies completion.

selfcheck.prompt: Where do you select a new infobase?
selfcheck.feedback: Infobase selection comes before application work.

options: The application description, without your future records

selfcheck.prompt: The new base has an empty customer list. What next?
options: Check the base and cleared search, then create a card
selfcheck.feedback: This is the expected beginning of a new service.

selfcheck.prompt: Where do you open customer records?
selfcheck.feedback: Designer describes the application; user lists are opened when it runs.

selfcheck.prompt: Existing customers are visible in the .cf load target. What is safer?
options: Cancel and prepare another new infobase
selfcheck.feedback: The first experiment’s target must be new and separate.

selfcheck.prompt: Name the application and mode you used, what the base stores and why the list is empty.
selfcheck.feedback: Compare your explanation with the walkthrough; it is not graded automatically.
